EC1: Receipt of DTaP [OR], IPV [OR], PCV13 [OR], or Hib prior to enrollment. Previous administration of the first dose of HBV is permitted
EC2: Anticipated receipt of any vaccine other than DTaP [OR], IPV [OR], HBV [OR], PCV13 [OR], or Hib during the first 60 hours after randomization
EC3: History of a severe allergic reaction [AND] (e.g. anaphylaxis) to a previous dose of any hepatitis B vaccine
EC4: History of a severe allergic reaction [AND] (e.g. anaphylaxis) to any component of the vaccines used in the study including neomycin [OR], yeast [OR] and polymyxin B
EC6: History of unstable progressive neurologic disorder of unknown cause
EC7: Known cause of apnea [AND] [NOT] other than apnea of prematurity
EC9: Child or parent/LAR is an immediate relative of study staff or an employee who is supervised by study staff.
EC10: Any condition that would, in the opinion of the site investigator, place the participant at an unacceptable risk of injury or render the participant unable to meet the requirements of the protocol
